Simulation and mission scenarios cover attitude and route control, waypoint configuration, return, and manual takeover. Log analysis develops judgment concerning route deviations, communications faults, and mission termination, supporting technical feedback between operations and engineering teams.

Payload, weight, power, and interface requirements inform flight control, localization, communications, and software configurations. Simulation, replay, and staged tests support error and fault analysis, documented through designs, configurations, and test reports.
課程架構分為六個模組，依專題需求組合系統基礎、操作訓練及研發實作。各模組列明技術: Six modules combine system foundations, operational training, and engineering practice according to project requirements. Technical topics, exercises, and engineering records define the scope and practical expectations of each module.
